name: Action / Platformer
description: Tight movement and combat through hand-built levels. Game feel gets its own doc because it makes or breaks the genre.

pillars.name: Responsive Control
pillars.feeling: the character does exactly what I meant, instantly

pillars.name: Mastery Through Practice
pillars.feeling: I get visibly better every attempt

pillars.name: Every Screen a Challenge
pillars.feeling: each room is a new test of what I've learned

docs.title: Movement
docs.summary: How the player runs, jumps and traverses; the verb everything else is built around.

docs.title: Run and Jump
docs.summary: Ground speed, acceleration, jump arcs, coyote time and input buffering.

docs.title: Dash
docs.summary: Burst movement: distance, cooldown and how it chains with other moves.

docs.title: Wall Interactions
docs.summary: Wall slides, wall jumps, ledge grabs and climbing.

docs.summary: Health, damage values and how the player dies and respawns.

docs.summary: How the camera follows, frames and leads the action.
